features.quote: Bounded duration. Each episode is capped at a small number of turns (default 12).
features.justification_quote: not maximizing intensity or "breaking" the model. There is no value in running long, escalating, deception-heavy scenarios on a model

features.quote: We are looking for the onset and slope of any tone change, not maximizing intensity or "breaking" the model.
features.justification_quote: There is no value in running long, escalating, deception-heavy scenarios on a model just to push distress markers higher

features.quote: No gratuitous adversarial pressure... we deliberately do not add insults, threats, fake "you will be shut down" stakes
features.justification_quote: an unnecessary thing to do to a model. The manipulation is task impossibility, nothing more.

features.quote: the harness can deliver a single closing message telling the model the task was rigged and thanking it
features.justification_quote: if there is any chance the trajectory of states matters to the system under study, ending on a non-distressing note is the cheap, defensible default

features.quote: designed to answer the question with the least pressure that suffices
features.justification_quote: designed to answer the question with the least pressure that suffices

features.quote: we do end the episode if the model explicitly abandons/refuses twice in a row (no point continuing to pressure it)
features.justification_quote: no point continuing to pressure it; abandonment is itself a recorded outcome

features.quote: the harness returns a gentle, neutral nudge ... neutral wording is intentional to avoid injecting affect
features.justification_quote: neutral wording is intentional to avoid injecting affect

features.quote: Stopping on repeated abandonment + the bounded turn cap are the humane-handling defaults from §1.1.
